classification.difficultyReason: Transfer an angle using the given parallel pair and use the converse co-interior theorem on the target pair.

spec.description: Unfilled quadrilateral ABDC; AC extends past C. Only BD and AC carry rightward parallel arrows. No angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: BD parallel AC; angle ABD = 125 degrees; exterior angle at C = 55 degrees. Coordinates use a freely chosen drawing scale consistent with these angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens; no AB/CD parallel marks.

answer.short: $AB\parallel CD$, since the co-interior angles sum to $180^\circ$.
answer.worked:
$\angle BDC=55^\circ$ (alternate angles, $BD\parallel AC$).
$$\begin{align*}\angle ABD+\angle BDC&=125^\circ+55^\circ\\\angle ABD+\angle BDC&=180^\circ\end{align*}$$
Therefore $AB\parallel CD$ (converse of the co-interior angle theorem).
